scene.ko: 뮤지컬 공연장에서 내 자리에 앉은 옆 사람과 좌석 번호를 정중하게 확인해 해결하고, 공연이 끝난 뒤 그 사람과 감상을 나눈다.

lines.en: Excuse me, I'm sorry, but I think you might be in my seat. I have H-14.
lines.ko: 실례합니다, 죄송한데 제 자리에 앉으신 것 같아요. 제가 H열 14번이거든요.
alt: Excuse me, sorry, but I think this is my seat. I'm in H-14.
Sorry to bother you, but I think you're in my seat. Mine is H-14.

lines.en: Oh, really? Let me check... Oh no, I'm in H-15. I'm so sorry!
lines.ko: 아, 그래요? 확인해 볼게요... 어머, 저는 H열 15번이네요. 정말 죄송해요!

lines.en: No worries at all. It's easy to mix up, especially in the dark.
lines.ko: 전혀 괜찮아요. 헷갈리기 쉽죠, 특히 어두울 때는요.
alt: Don't worry about it. It's easy to mix up in the dark.
It's totally fine. It happens a lot in the dark.

lines.en: Thanks for being so nice about it. Is this your first time seeing Winter Harbor?
lines.ko: 좋게 넘어가 주셔서 고마워요. «겨울 항구»는 처음 보세요?

lines.en: Yes, it is. I've heard the second act is really moving.
alt: Yes, it's my first time. People say the second act is very moving.

lines.en: Well, that was amazing! What did you think of the ending?
It was incredible. I got goosebumps during the final song. I didn't see that ending coming.
lines.ko: 정말 굉장했어요. 마지막 노래에서 소름이 돋았어요. 그런 결말일 줄은 몰랐어요.
alt: Amazing. The last song gave me goosebumps. I didn't expect that ending at all.

lines.en: Me neither! Some people say the old sailor was a ghost the whole time. Do you think so?
lines.ko: 저도요! 늙은 선원이 처음부터 유령이었다고 하는 사람들도 있더라고요. 그렇게 생각하세요?

lines.en: Hmm, I'm not so sure. To me, he felt more like a memory than a ghost. Maybe that's why the stage went so quiet whenever he appeared.
lines.ko: 음, 글쎄요. 저한테는 유령보다는 기억처럼 느껴졌어요. 그래서 그가 나올 때마다 무대가 그렇게 조용해졌나 봐요.
alt: I'm not sure. He felt more like a memory to me. That might be why the stage got so quiet.

lines.en: Oh, I love that idea. Now I want to see it again just to watch for that!
lines.ko: 아, 그 생각 정말 좋네요. 그것만 보러 다시 보고 싶어지네요!

expressions.en: I think you might be in my seat.

expressions.note: mix up = 혼동하다 · 상대를 편하게 해 줄 때
